thread:
Nina: Heads-up: codegen is emitting bare `list` and `dict` in a few endpoints. Pyright shows everything as Any and autocomplete is gone in sample apps. Minimal repro in samples attached.

Nina: repro:
```py
resp = client.get_invoice('i1')
item = resp.line_items[0]
# item.product.name -> shows as Any, no completion
```

Omar: I inspected generated models: `line_items: Optional[list] = None`. That's the culprit.

Ravi: short-term: add a pyi stub in redwood/types mapping get_invoice -> Optional[InvoiceModel] and annotate lists properly. Longer term: generator should emit List[LineItemModel] when items.schema has properties.

Nina: also spotted streaming endpoints typed as AsyncIterator[Any]. That confuses users. We need AsyncIterator[EventModel].

TypeBot: CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/pyright/1190 shows failures for samples.

Omar: proposal for generator fallback rules:
- arrays with $ref or properties -> List[Model]
- arrays with additionalProperties only -> List[Json]
- objects with properties -> BaseModel subclass
- objects without properties -> Dict[str, Json]
- define Json = Union[str,int,float,bool,None,Dict[str, "Json"],List["Json"]]

Ravi: I can add Json alias and export from models.__init__. Also add a tiny pyright regression test that runs against a generated bundle.

Nina: can one of you own landing the pyi stub for the hosted SDK so customers have good DX immediately?

Omar: I'll open a PR for the pyi and CI test. Assigning Ravi to the generator change.

Ravi: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/734 for the generator and typed streams.

Nina: thanks. I'll update the devex samples README to recommend the pyi-pinned workaround until the micro release ships.
